exposure: Brain-sparing effect (BSE) of fetal growth restriction (FGR)
outcome: Germinal matrix/intraventricular hemorrhage (GM/IVH) (Grade I-II and Grade III-IV)
cohort: The study included 320 patients who delivered prior to the 34th gestational week, with a specific analysis focusing on 201 newborns divided into early FGR with abnormal CPR and appropriate for gestational age groups.
finding: The rate of GM-IVH was increased in the group possessing early FGR with abnormal CPR, but multivariate logistic regression analysis showed that BSE was not an independent risk factor for GM/IVH.
mod_finding: Emergency CS delivery was not independently associated with the primary outcome of GM/IVH.
gest_age: Delivered prior to the 34th gestational week
